edges: Malaria is fundamentally a disease of poverty.
Malaria parasites feed on hemoglobin in red blood cells.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Voluntary workers are not entitled to receive the minimum wage.
The UK developed and launched six satellites from 1962 to 1979 in collaboration with NASA.
Armed service personnel are not entitled to receive the minimum wage.
Most workers in the UK over the age of 16 are legally entitled to a minimum rate of pay called the national minimum wage.
Workers under school leaving age are not entitled to receive the minimum wage.
Genuinely self-employed workers are not entitled to receive the minimum wage.
The UK did not play a role in the 'Space Race' between the world's two military superpowers.
Some apprentices are not entitled to receive the minimum wage.

edges: Malaria is a disease that has been effectively eradicated in the UK.
Malaria was a major cause of illness and death in Southern Europe.
